title: Tangerine Breakline
creation_method: Independent deterministic C# minor–A–E–B Drum & Bass game movement and new F# minor–D–A–E half-time answer movement for a 120-second stream master; generated oscillators and seeded noise only, no sampled source audio or repeated first-minute loop

art_provenance.revision_reason: Replace the early glossy beat-pad scene with duohertz comic print while keeping five syncopated tangerine pads
art_provenance.cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 into a NEW original SQUARE 1:1 cover-art candidate for duohertz track Tangerine Breakline. Image 1 is CONTENT reference only: preserve its unmistakable syncopated chain of bright tangerine square beat pads ascending diagonally, with cyan dotted rhythm hopping across the gaps. Remove the dark teal 3D environment, shiny rounded plastic, realistic depth/glow, water-like horizon and tiny particles entirely. Image 2 is STYLE reference only for near-black ink, warm-ivory paper cutouts, coral/electric-cyan accent discipline, large halftone print texture and forceful angular editorial layout. Do not copy Image 2's circular rings or radial waveform. Build a strong paper-print silhouette with FIVE large flat tangerine/coral square beat pads at staggered heights on a broken diagonal from lower left to upper right. Each pad should have one warm-ivory concentric square target, not a circle. ONE electric-cyan dotted syncopation line visibly jumps across all five pads; at two gaps its dots break into sharp zigzag offsets to convey drum-and-bass breakbeats. Use warm-ivory paper slash marks and restrained halftone, with a quiet near-black lower fifth for later local title overlay. Distinct from paper planes and the skipline's broad continuous ribbon; readable at 100px and joyful for all ages. No realistic scenery, water, sky, photorealistic lights, planes, lanterns, rings, characters, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit this newly redrawn original Tangerine Breakline square cover into a NEW HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve FIVE bold tangerine/coral paper beat pads with warm-ivory square targets, a single electric-cyan dotted syncopation line visibly hopping across their diagonal gaps with two broken zigzag offsets, forceful warm-ivory paper slashes, near-black ink and halftone. Recompose the beat-pad action on the RIGHT two-thirds so the five-pad silhouette and dotted breakline remain distinct at social-card size; reserve a quiet near-black LEFT third. Add EXACTLY TWO crisp fully readable English text lines on the left: 'duohertz' all lowercase in electric cyan, and 'Tangerine Breakline' in larger warm ivory. Spell both EXACTLY, do not truncate. Designed horizontal composition, not stretched square. No other words, letters, numbers, realistic water or sky, planes, lanterns, rings, characters, logos, watermark or copied game art.

previous_art_provenance.cover_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square, text-free album-cover background for an internal duohertz electronic rhythm-game candidate
Primary request: Create distinctive cover art for “Tangerine Breakline”, a joyful all-ages Drum & Bass track. Show a sequence of floating tangerine-orange percussive tiles making a syncopated zigzag path through a deep teal sound field. Small cyan wave dots and short soft gold pulses leap between the offset tiles, suggesting a playful fast breakbeat. This is abstract music geometry, not literal fruit or a vehicle.
Style/medium: polished contemporary editorial electronic album illustration with tactile luminous tiles, subtle depth and crisp readable forms at small thumbnail size.
Composition/framing: square; the zigzag begins lower left and climbs toward upper right, with a calm dark teal lower band reserved for a separate local title overlay.
Color palette: tangerine, soft coral, cyan, pale cream and deep teal.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, people, characters, cars, weapons, food, red neon city, flashing or strobing stripes, copied game imagery, sky racing ribbons, helixes, paper fins, copper lanterns, aurora stones, interlocking circular rings or sunset glass horizon.
